notes_for_editor: Access is not verified. No official Forest Service page for this lookout was found, so facts.access is omitted. The road details come from a third-party road guide and may be out of date. Whether the tower is open to visitors is unknown. Staffing (seasonal) is from the 2020 report and may be out of date. The 1936 survey datasheet mention of a lookout station may describe an earlier structure or only the survey marker's surroundings; it is recorded as an unresolved 'other' event. The CL-100 cab detail is attributed on the Forest Lookouts page to Lookouts of the Southwestern Region (USFS); that book was not checked directly. No fire, removal or relocation was found. The record's status (standing) is not contradicted, but the latest source is dated 2020.
